website.headline:
A passing thought.
A place to keep it.
website.lead: Capture ideas, reading notes, and everyday observations. Use search and tags to return to the thoughts worth taking further.
website.status: First macOS release in preparation · macOS 14 or later · Notes stored locally
features: Create a text note for a sentence, a reading note, or an unfinished idea. No account is needed.
Search your notes and combine filters for tags, source, and time. Add structure with nested tags.
This first release stores data on your Mac. Pin what matters, archive finished notes, and recover deleted notes from Trash.
support_sections: Choose New Spark in the toolbar, write your text, and save. Select a note to continue editing. A Spark is simply a note.
Use the search field or ⌘F to find text, then narrow the results by tags, source, time, or status. Write #tag or #parent/child in a note to organize it on the Tags page.

Use the Mac share sheet, Safari extension, Shortcuts, or Mac Services to save text. Enable the Safari extension in Safari → Settings → Extensions and choose which websites it may access. Web captures save selected text, titles, links, and your annotations.

This release stores notes and organization records in local storage dedicated to the app. Notes do not automatically sync between Macs. Copy important notes into a separate document and back up your Mac regularly.

Show in System Search is enabled by default. It adds note titles, text excerpts, and tags to local Spotlight. Turn it off in Jotra settings to request removal of the app’s index. Show Recent Views controls whether home cards are visible; recent searches can be deleted individually or cleared.

Deleting a note moves it to Trash first. Items older than 30 days are removed when the app next performs cleanup. You may permanently delete them earlier or empty Trash. Permanent deletion cannot be undone in the app; separate system backups remain under your control.
Upgrading from an earlier test build
Back up important notes and keep the earlier app’s data before upgrading. If earlier notes do not appear, contact support before clearing data or deleting the old files.
This macOS release focuses on local text notes, search, and organization. iCloud sync, Agent and AI features, subscriptions, and in-app Markdown export or automatic backup are not included.
Email hello@go2come.com with your macOS version, app version, and steps to reproduce the issue. Hide private notes in screenshots. You do not need to send your database, passwords, or keys.
privacy_sections: This policy covers the first local-notebook macOS release of Jotra, provided by Manbao Interactive Entertainment Limited, and the Jotra product, support, and privacy pages on henkeyi.com and jotra.henkeyi.com. Other products hosted on henkeyi.com have their own notices.

Note text, titles, links, sources, dates, tags, organization states, recent views, and recent searches are stored on your Mac. System capture features may first place content in local App Group storage before the main app imports it. This release does not upload that content to the developer through its app features and does not enable iCloud sync, AI services, or remote Agents.

The share sheet receives text, links, and annotations you provide. When enabled, Safari capture scripts run on websites you authorize and read page titles, URLs, selected text, or context-menu links for preview and capture. Saved content passes through a local extension into your notes rather than our relay server. Manage website access or disable the extension in Safari settings. Shortcuts and Mac Services receive text supplied to that action; the app does not continuously monitor the general clipboard. Siri voice features are provided by Apple’s system services.

Spotlight is enabled by default. The app submits titles, the first 300 characters of note text, and tags from active and archived notes to the local system search index. Turning this off requests removal of the app’s index; completion depends on the system and runtime state. Up to five recent views and ten recent searches are stored locally. Show Recent Views only hides home cards; it does not stop recording or clear history. Recent searches can be deleted or cleared on the search page.

This release contains no advertising, cross-app tracking, analytics, or third-party crash-reporting SDK. Copy writes note text to the system clipboard. Opening an external link, support page, or email invokes other services whose own practices apply. Apple may process App Store, system, or diagnostic information according to your settings; this is separate from data collection by the developer through this app.

Cloudflare hosts the Jotra pages. Delivering pages, providing security, and troubleshooting may involve IP addresses, request times, browser information, and request or error logs. These Jotra pages do not embed advertising or analytics scripts and do not require an account. Necessary website request information is separate from note data. See Cloudflare’s privacy policy.

If you email us, we receive your email address and the content you choose to provide. We use it to reply, investigate, and resolve the issue. Avoid sending passwords, keys, or unnecessary private notes. Request deletion of personal information in support correspondence at the same email address, subject to any legally required retention.

Notes normally remain until you delete them. Ordinary deletion moves them to Trash; items older than 30 days are deleted during app cleanup, or you may permanently delete them earlier. Recent records update within their limits. Deletion removes data at the app level; it is not a promise of physical secure erasure and cannot automatically delete separately saved files or system backups. Uninstalling the app does not guarantee removal of every copy.

Edit or delete notes, empty Trash, manage recent searches, turn off Spotlight, and adjust extension website permissions. Protect your Mac login, use suitable device security, and keep backups safe. This release has no app account to close and does not claim independent note encryption or end-to-end encryption.
If later versions add sync, AI, or other data processing, we will update the relevant notices. For policy questions or personal-information requests, email hello@go2come.com.
